company.name: Mala'a Technologies
company.shortDescription: Mala'a Technologies is a finance management app that helps manage finances and provides recommendations on finances.
company.description: Mala'a Technologies provides a way to manage all financial matters from several bank accounts in one location. It supports tracking costs, keeping an eye on credit, and investing money. Mala'a Technologies enables people to make more informed financial decisions.

productsAndServices.description: A financial planning software that helps users manage their finances by aggregating multiple bank accounts, tracking expenses, monitoring credit levels, and setting financial goals.
productsAndServices.name: Mala'a Financial Planner

productsAndServices.description: Automated investment advisory and robo-advisory services that provide users with diversified investment portfolios aligned with their risk tolerance and financial goals.
productsAndServices.name: Mala'a Investment Advisory Services

productsAndServices.description: Tools within the app that enable users to categorize, track, and analyze their spending, and apply budgeting rules such as the 50/30/20 rule to manage income and expenses.
productsAndServices.name: Expense Management and Budgeting Tools

productsAndServices.description: A service that securely aggregates financial data from multiple third-party financial institutions into a unified dashboard for user convenience and financial analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Account Aggregation Service

productsAndServices.description: A data privacy and security framework ensuring user data is collected, processed, and stored securely in compliance with Saudi regulations and industry standards.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Data Privacy and Security Framework

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $17,320,710, or 91.04% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $12,120,047 to $79,830,370, a 6.59x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 66 (-1).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
